name: Choumai Sui
source:
A mysterious girl encountered in this world 13 years in the past. She claims to be [url=/c154189]Yumeto[/url]’s senior, though he has no memory of her.
She single-handedly runs the "Historical Literature Research Club", and dabbles in black magic within the clubroom.

[Translated from [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/nh/#character]official website[/url]]
